player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed say {num_rounds}-round na IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Say panag-guess mo ed sagpot na round, isabi so saray numero a {min_guess} tan {max_guess}.
Deskes na duara so inilibit, say target et (2/3)x(average na duara inilibit),
Tan say player a anggaogep so inilibit to et mas liket ed target so agna ed round.
Isagot mo so inilibit mo ed format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aliwan duga so format; ipasa yo pa ed [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Say panag-isip et nepeg ya walad baetan na {min_guess} tan {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_win: Say manalo ed round et say player {winner}!

outcome.p0_wins: Mas dakel so analo na Player 0.
outcome.p1_wins: Say unona et dakel so analo to.
outcome.draw: Diad interon dula et anggapoy agawaan.
